scenes.title: Facebook said no to him.
scenes.say: Facebook turned him down for a job.

scenes.label: Brian Acton was rejected by Twitter and Facebook, then co-founded WhatsApp
scenes.say: In twenty oh nine, Twitter and Facebook both turned down Brian Acton. That year, he joined Jan Koum to build WhatsApp.

scenes.label: Facebook's deal to buy WhatsApp, announced in 2014
scenes.say: In twenty fourteen, Facebook agreed to buy WhatsApp for about nineteen billion dollars.
